name: Y20 Ultra Smart Watch Sports Edition | 2.2 HD Display Bluetooth Calling Fitness Tracker
description:
The Y20 Ultra Smart Watch is designed for active lifestyles, combining powerful fitness tracking with modern connectivity. Its 2.2-inch HD display delivers crystal-clear visuals for calls, messages, and health monitoring. With heart rate, blood pressure, SpO₂, temperature, and sleep tracking, plus multiple sports modes, it helps you stay on top of your health and workouts. Packed with Bluetooth calling, music control, camera remote, and app notifications, it offers convenience and performance all day with wireless charging and a 320mAh battery.
Key Features
 2.2-inch HD display for clear visuals
 Heart rate, BP, SpO₂, temperature, and sleep monitoring
 Bluetooth calling and smart notifications
 Multi-sport modes with step and calorie tracking
 Wireless charging with 320mAh long battery life
 Remote music, camera, and voice control
Ingredients / Materials
Alloy body, Silicone strap, Electronic components
How to Use
 Charge fully before first use
 Connect via companion app on Android or iOS
 Wear on wrist and adjust straps for comfort
 Track workouts, health metrics, and notifications
Package Includes
 1 × Y20 Ultra Smart Watch
 1 × Wireless Charger
 1 × User Manual
